name: Urbanus
title: Fellow Worker in Christ
summary: Urbanus was a Christian in Rome whom Paul greets in his letter to the Romans. He is described as a fellow worker in Christ, indicating that he was actively involved in the church's work and service.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a personal greeting to Urbanus in his letter to the church in Rome, calling him his fellow worker in Christ.

keyEvents.title: Recognized as a Fellow Worker
keyEvents.description: By calling Urbanus a 'fellow worker in Christ,' Paul shows that he was an active participant in the spread of the gospel and the building up of the church in Rome.
